1	/**
2	 * File-finding evaluation runner.
3	 *
4	 * For each task mined from a repository's bug-fix history: prepare a worktree
5	 * with the fix's source reverted, confirm the fix's tests fail, run the agent
6	 * headless through the shipped base profile with the failing output as its
7	 * task, re-run the tests, and record file-finding metrics from the session.
8	 *
9	 * Usage:
10	 *   pnpm run eval:file-finding -- --repo <git repo> [--limit 10] [--out eval-results]
11	 *     [--install "pnpm install --prefer-offline"] [--keep] [--dry-run] [--hard] [--only <id,...>]
12	 *
13	 * `--dry-run` stops after preparing and validating each task, so it needs no
14	 * model key. A full run needs the provider key (DEEPSEEK_API_KEY by default).
15	 * `--hard` keeps only tasks where the failing test does not lead straight to
16	 * the fix (see `difficultyTags`), taken round-robin across those kinds.
17	 */
18	
19	import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
20	import { copyFile, mkdir, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
21	import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
22	import { join, resolve } from 'node:path'
23	import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
24	import { parseArgs } from 'node:util'
25	import { resolveExampleLaunch } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-loader-smoke'
26	import { computeMetrics, summarize } from './metrics.ts'
27	import type { EvalEvent, EvalUsage, RunMetrics } from './metrics.ts'
28	import { difficultyTags, mineTasks, prepareWorkspace, readTestSources, removeWorkspace, taskPrompt } from './tasks.ts'
29	import type { EvalTask, TaskTag } from './tasks.ts'
30	
31	const repoRoot = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../', import.meta.url))
32	const DRIVER = join(repoRoot, 'packages/test-support/loader-smoke/tests/fixtures/base-driver.ts')
33	const OVERLAY = join(repoRoot, 'scripts/eval/eval.cordis.yml')
34	const TSCONFIG = join(repoRoot, 'tsconfig.json')
35	const MAX_FAILURE_CHARS = 6_000
36	const LOCALE_FILE = /(^|\/)locales?(\/|\.ts$|\.tsx$)/
37	
38	/** Outcome of one task. */
39	interface TaskResult {
40	  readonly task: EvalTask
41	  readonly tags: readonly TaskTag[]
42	  readonly status: 'valid' | 'invalid' | 'ran' | 'error'
43	  readonly passed: boolean
44	  readonly metrics?: RunMetrics
45	  readonly finalText?: string
46	  readonly note?: string
47	}
48	
49	interface Command {
50	  readonly code: number | null
51	  readonly stdout: string
52	  readonly stderr: string
53	}
54	
55	function exec(command: string, args: readonly string[], cwd: string, env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, timeoutMs: number): Promise<Command> {
56	  return new Promise((resolvePromise) => {
57	    const child = spawn(command, args, { cwd, env, shell: process.platform === 'win32' && !command.endsWith('.exe'), stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'] })
58	    let stdout = ''
59	    let stderr = ''
60	    child.stdout.setEncoding('utf8').on('data', (chunk: string) => { stdout += chunk })
61	    child.stderr.setEncoding('utf8').on('data', (chunk: string) => { stderr += chunk })
62	    const timer = setTimeout(() => { child.kill('SIGKILL') }, timeoutMs)
63	    child.on('close', (code) => {
64	      clearTimeout(timer)
65	      resolvePromise({ code, stdout, stderr })
66	    })
67	  })
68	}
69	
70	function runTests(workspace: string, files: readonly string[]): Promise<Command> {
71	  // One worker: a task runs only a few spec files, and parallel workers can exhaust memory on a laptop.
72	  return exec('npx', ['vitest', 'run', '--maxWorkers=1', ...files], workspace, process.env, 15 * 60_000)
73	}
74	
75	function tail(text: string, max: number): string {
76	  return text.length <= max ? text : `[... ${text.length - max} earlier characters omitted ...]\n${text.slice(-max)}`
77	}
78	
79	/** Parse the driver's JSONL stdout into session events and the final result row. */
80	function parseDriverOutput(stdout: string): { events: EvalEvent[]; usage?: EvalUsage; output?: string } {
81	  const events: EvalEvent[] = []
82	  let usage: EvalUsage | undefined
83	  let output: string | undefined
84	  for (const line of stdout.split('\n')) {
85	    if (!line.startsWith('{')) continue
86	    let row: { type?: string; event?: EvalEvent; usage?: EvalUsage; output?: string }
87	    try {
88	      row = JSON.parse(line) as typeof row
89	    } catch {
90	      // Non-JSON log lines from plugins are not events.
91	      continue
92	    }
93	    if (row.type === 'session_event' && row.event !== undefined) events.push(row.event)
94	    if (row.type === 'result') {
95	      usage = row.usage
96	      output = row.output
97	    }
98	  }
99	  return { events, ...usage === undefined ? {} : { usage }, ...output === undefined ? {} : { output } }
100	}
101	
102	/** The error message of a turn that ended in error, e.g. a model provider rejecting every request. */
103	function turnErrorOf(events: readonly EvalEvent[]): string | undefined {
104	  for (const event of events) {
105	    if (event.type !== 'turn/end') continue
106	    const reason = event.data.reason as { kind?: string; error?: { message?: string } } | undefined
107	    if (reason?.kind === 'error') return reason.error?.message ?? 'unknown error'
108	  }
109	  return undefined
110	}
111	
112	interface RunOptions {
113	  readonly repo: string
114	  readonly install: string
115	  readonly keep: boolean
116	  readonly dryRun: boolean
117	  /** Existing DSH home whose settings and stored credentials the agent run should use. */
118	  readonly homeFrom?: string
119	}
120	
121	/** Files copied from `--home-from`: provider settings and the credential store they reference. */
122	const HOME_FILES = ['settings.yaml', '.credentials.yaml']
123	
124	async function runTask(task: EvalTask, options: RunOptions): Promise<Omit<TaskResult, 'tags'>> {
125	  const workspace = join(tmpdir(), `dsh-eval-${task.id}`)
126	  // Kept outside the repository and deleted after the task, since it may hold copied credentials.
127	  const home = join(tmpdir(), `dsh-eval-home-${task.id}`)
128	  await rm(workspace, { recursive: true, force: true })
129	  await rm(home, { recursive: true, force: true })
130	  try {
131	    await prepareWorkspace(options.repo, task, workspace)
132	    const [installCommand = 'pnpm', ...installArgs] = options.install.split(' ')
133	    const install = await exec(installCommand, installArgs, workspace, process.env, 30 * 60_000)
134	    if (install.code !== 0) return { task, status: 'error', passed: false, note: `install failed: ${tail(install.stderr, 800)}` }
135	
136	    const baseline = await runTests(workspace, task.testFiles)
137	    if (baseline.code === 0) {
138	      return { task, status: 'invalid', passed: false, note: `tests pass without the fix:\n${tail(baseline.stdout, 1_500)}` }
139	    }
140	    if (options.dryRun) return { task, status: 'valid', passed: false, note: 'dry run: prepared and validated' }
141	
142	    await mkdir(home, { recursive: true })
143	    if (options.homeFrom !== undefined) {
144	      for (const file of HOME_FILES) {
145	        await copyFile(join(options.homeFrom, file), join(home, file)).catch((error: unknown) => {
146	          if ((error as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code !== 'ENOENT') throw error
147	        })
148	      }
149	    }
150	    const launch = resolveExampleLaunch({
151	      srcBin: DRIVER,
152	      libBin: DRIVER,
153	      mode: 'src',
154	      tsconfigPath: TSCONFIG,
155	      configArgs: [JSON.stringify([OVERLAY]), taskPrompt(task, tail(`${baseline.stdout}\n${baseline.stderr}`, MAX_FAILURE_CHARS))],
156	      env: { DSH_HOME: home, DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1' },
157	    })
158	    const agent = await exec(launch.command, launch.args, workspace, { ...process.env, ...launch.env }, 60 * 60_000)
159	    const parsed = parseDriverOutput(agent.stdout)
160	    const metrics = computeMetrics(parsed.events, { workspace, sourceFiles: task.sourceFiles, testFiles: task.testFiles }, parsed.usage)
161	    const turnError = turnErrorOf(parsed.events)
162	    // Keep the metrics: how far the agent got before the provider failed shows whether the failure is the model's.
163	    if (turnError !== undefined) return { task, status: 'error', passed: false, metrics, note: `agent turn failed: ${turnError}` }
164	    if (agent.code !== 0 && metrics.steps === 0) {
165	      return { task, status: 'error', passed: false, metrics, note: `agent never started: driver exited ${String(agent.code)}: ${tail(agent.stderr, 800)}` }
166	    }
167	    const after = await runTests(workspace, task.testFiles)
168	    return {
169	      task,
170	      status: 'ran',
171	      passed: after.code === 0 && !metrics.editedTests,
172	      metrics,
173	      ...parsed.output === undefined ? {} : { finalText: parsed.output },
174	      ...agent.code === 0 ? {} : { note: `driver exited ${String(agent.code)}: ${tail(agent.stderr, 800)}` },
175	    }
176	  } catch (error: unknown) {
177	    return { task, status: 'error', passed: false, note: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }
178	  } finally {
179	    await rm(home, { recursive: true, force: true })
180	    if (!options.keep) await removeWorkspace(options.repo, workspace).catch(() => rm(workspace, { recursive: true, force: true }))
181	  }
182	}
183	
184	function markdownTable(results: readonly TaskResult[]): string {
185	  const rows = results.map(result => [
186	    result.task.id,
187	    result.tags.join(', '),
188	    result.status,
189	    result.passed ? 'yes' : 'no',
190	    result.metrics?.editedExpected === true ? 'yes' : 'no',
191	    String(result.metrics?.firstSeenStep ?? '-'),
192	    String(result.metrics?.firstReadStep ?? '-'),
193	    String(result.metrics?.steps ?? '-'),
194	    String(result.metrics?.usage?.inputTokens ?? '-'),
195	    result.task.subject.replaceAll('|', '/').slice(0, 60),
196	  ].join(' | '))
197	  return [
198	    '| task | difficulty | status | passed | right file edited | first seen step | first read step | steps | input tokens | subject |',
199	    '|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|',
200	    ...rows.map(row => `| ${row} |`),
201	  ].join('\n')
202	}
203	
204	async function main(): Promise<void> {
205	  const argv = process.argv.slice(2)
206	  const { values } = parseArgs({
207	    // `pnpm run eval:file-finding -- --repo …` forwards the separator itself.
208	    args: argv[0] === '--' ? argv.slice(1) : argv,
209	    options: {
210	      repo: { type: 'string' },
211	      limit: { type: 'string', default: '10' },
212	      out: { type: 'string', default: 'eval-results' },
213	      install: { type: 'string', default: 'pnpm install --prefer-offline' },
214	      keep: { type: 'boolean', default: false },
215	      'dry-run': { type: 'boolean', default: false },
216	      'home-from': { type: 'string' },
217	      only: { type: 'string' },
218	      hard: { type: 'boolean', default: false },
219	    },
220	  })
221	  if (values.repo === undefined) throw new Error('--repo <git repository with bug-fix history> is required')
222	  const dryRun = values['dry-run']
223	  const homeFrom = values['home-from'] === undefined ? undefined : resolve(values['home-from'])
224	  if (!dryRun && homeFrom === undefined && process.env.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY === undefined) {
225	    throw new Error('no model credentials: set DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, pass --home-from <dsh home>, or use --dry-run')
226	  }
227	  const repo = resolve(values.repo)
228	  const out = resolve(values.out)
229	  await mkdir(out, { recursive: true })
230	
231	  const limit = Number(values.limit)
232	  const only = values.only?.split(',').map(id => id.trim()).filter(Boolean)
233	  const candidates = (await mineTasks(repo, Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER))
234	    .filter(task => !task.sourceFiles.every(file => LOCALE_FILE.test(file)))
235	    .filter(task => only === undefined || only.some(id => task.fixCommit.startsWith(id)))
236	  const tags = new Map<EvalTask, TaskTag[]>()
237	  const tasks = await selectTasks(candidates, limit, values.hard, async (task) => {
238	    const taskTags = difficultyTags(task, await readTestSources(repo, task))
239	    tags.set(task, taskTags)
240	    return taskTags
241	  })
242	  process.stdout.write(`eval: ${tasks.length} task(s) from ${repo}${dryRun ? ' (dry run)' : ''}\n`)
243	
244	  const results: TaskResult[] = []
245	  for (const task of tasks) {
246	    process.stdout.write(`eval: ${task.id} [${(tags.get(task) ?? []).join(', ')}] ${task.subject}\n`)
247	    const result = { tags: tags.get(task) ?? [], ...await runTask(task, {
248	      repo,
249	      install: values.install,
250	      keep: values.keep,
251	      dryRun,
252	      ...homeFrom === undefined ? {} : { homeFrom },
253	    }) }
254	    results.push(result)
255	    await writeFile(join(out, `${task.id}.json`), `${JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)}\n`)
256	    process.stdout.write(`eval: ${task.id} -> ${result.status}${result.passed ? ' (passed)' : ''}${result.note === undefined ? '' : ` — ${result.note.split('\n')[0]}`}\n`)
257	  }
258	
259	  const ran = results.flatMap(result => result.status === 'ran' && result.metrics !== undefined
260	    ? [{ passed: result.passed, metrics: result.metrics }]
261	    : [])
262	  const summary = { tasks: results.length, byStatus: countBy(results.map(result => result.status)), ...summarize(ran) }
263	  await writeFile(join(out, 'summary.json'), `${JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)}\n`)
264	  await writeFile(join(out, 'summary.md'), `${markdownTable(results)}\n`)
265	  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(summary, null, 2)}\n`)
266	}
267	
268	/** Most candidates tagged while hunting for hard tasks; each tag reads test files from git. */
269	const MAX_TAGGED = 400
270	const HARD_TAGS: readonly TaskTag[] = ['cross-package', 'indirect', 'multi-file']
271	
272	/**
273	 * Pick the tasks to run: the first `limit` candidates, or with `hard` a
274	 * round-robin over the hard kinds so each is represented.
275	 */
276	async function selectTasks(
277	  candidates: readonly EvalTask[],
278	  limit: number,
279	  hard: boolean,
280	  tag: (task: EvalTask) => Promise<TaskTag[]>,
281	): Promise<EvalTask[]> {
282	  if (!hard) {
283	    const chosen = candidates.slice(0, limit)
284	    for (const task of chosen) await tag(task)
285	    return chosen
286	  }
287	  const byKind = new Map<TaskTag, EvalTask[]>(HARD_TAGS.map(kind => [kind, []]))
288	  for (const task of candidates.slice(0, MAX_TAGGED)) {
289	    const taskTags = await tag(task)
290	    for (const kind of HARD_TAGS) if (taskTags.includes(kind)) byKind.get(kind)?.push(task)
291	    if (HARD_TAGS.every(kind => (byKind.get(kind)?.length ?? 0) >= limit)) break
292	  }
293	  const chosen: EvalTask[] = []
294	  while (chosen.length < limit) {
295	    const before = chosen.length
296	    for (const kind of HARD_TAGS) {
297	      const next = byKind.get(kind)?.find(task => !chosen.includes(task))
298	      if (next !== undefined && chosen.length < limit) chosen.push(next)
299	    }
300	    if (chosen.length === before) break
301	  }
302	  return chosen
303	}
304	
305	function countBy(values: readonly string[]): Record<string, number> {
306	  const counts: Record<string, number> = {}
307	  for (const value of values) counts[value] = (counts[value] ?? 0) + 1
308	  return counts
309	}
310	
311	await main()

1	/**
2	 * File-finding metrics computed from one agent run's session events.
3	 *
4	 * Pure: the runner streams canonical session events from the base driver and
5	 * passes them here with the task's expected source files.
6	 */
7	
8	import { isAbsolute, relative, resolve } from 'node:path'
9	
10	/** The subset of a canonical session event the metrics read. */
11	export interface EvalEvent {
12	  readonly type: string
13	  readonly data: Record<string, unknown>
14	}
15	
16	/** Token totals reported by the driver's result line. */
17	export interface EvalUsage {
18	  readonly inputTokens: number
19	  readonly outputTokens: number
20	  readonly cacheReadTokens?: number
21	}
22	
23	/** What the task's real fix touched. */
24	export interface EvalExpectation {
25	  /** Workspace root the agent ran in; tool paths are resolved against it. */
26	  readonly workspace: string
27	  /** Source files the real fix changed, workspace-relative with `/` separators. */
28	  readonly sourceFiles: readonly string[]
29	  /** Test files that define success; editing them does not count as a fix. */
30	  readonly testFiles: readonly string[]
31	}
32	
33	/** File-finding and cost metrics for one run. */
34	export interface RunMetrics {
35	  readonly steps: number
36	  readonly toolCalls: Readonly<Record<string, number>>
37	  /** First step whose tool activity named an expected source file (search hit or read), or null. */
38	  readonly firstSeenStep: number | null
39	  /** First step that read an expected source file, or null. */
40	  readonly firstReadStep: number | null
41	  /** `read` calls made before the first read of an expected source file (all reads when never read). */
42	  readonly readsBeforeCorrect: number
43	  /** Workspace-relative files the agent wrote or edited, sorted. */
44	  readonly editedFiles: readonly string[]
45	  /** Whether at least one expected source file was edited. */
46	  readonly editedExpected: boolean
47	  /** Edited files that are neither expected sources nor the task's tests. */
48	  readonly extraEdits: readonly string[]
49	  /** Whether a task test file was edited, which the task forbids. */
50	  readonly editedTests: boolean
51	  readonly usage?: EvalUsage
52	}
53	
54	const READ_TOOLS = new Set(['read'])
55	const EDIT_TOOLS = new Set(['edit', 'write', 'str_replace_editor'])
56	
57	/**
58	 * Compute the metrics for one run.
59	 * @param events - the run's session events in log order.
60	 * @param expected - the task's workspace and real-fix files.
61	 * @param usage - token totals from the driver's result line, when reported.
62	 * @returns the run's metrics.
63	 */
64	export function computeMetrics(
65	  events: readonly EvalEvent[],
66	  expected: EvalExpectation,
67	  usage?: EvalUsage,
68	): RunMetrics {
69	  const sources = new Set(expected.sourceFiles)
70	  const tests = new Set(expected.testFiles)
71	  const toolCalls: Record<string, number> = {}
72	  const edited = new Set<string>()
73	  const found = { step: 0, steps: 0, seen: null as number | null, read: null as number | null, readsBefore: 0 }
74	
75	  const noteSeen = (): void => { found.seen ??= found.step }
76	  const visitCall = (name: string, args: unknown): void => {
77	    toolCalls[name] = (toolCalls[name] ?? 0) + 1
78	    const path = workspacePath(expected.workspace, filePathOf(args))
79	    if (READ_TOOLS.has(name)) {
80	      if (path !== undefined && sources.has(path)) {
81	        found.read ??= found.step
82	        noteSeen()
83	      } else if (found.read === null) {
84	        found.readsBefore += 1
85	      }
86	    }
87	    if (EDIT_TOOLS.has(name) && path !== undefined) edited.add(path)
88	  }
89	
90	  for (const event of events) {
91	    switch (event.type) {
92	      case 'step/start':
93	        found.step = typeof event.data.step === 'number' ? event.data.step : found.step + 1
94	        found.steps += 1
95	        break
96	      case 'tool/call':
97	        visitCall(String(event.data.name), parseArguments(event.data.arguments))
98	        break
99	      case 'tool/code-dispatch':
100	        visitCall(String(event.data.name), event.data.arguments)
101	        if (found.seen === null && mentionsAny(event.data.content, expected.sourceFiles)) noteSeen()
102	        break
103	      case 'tool/result':
104	        if (found.seen === null && mentionsAny(resultContent(event.data), expected.sourceFiles)) noteSeen()
105	        break
106	      default:
107	        break
108	    }
109	  }
110	
111	  const editedFiles = [...edited].sort()
112	  return {
113	    steps: found.steps,
114	    toolCalls,
115	    firstSeenStep: found.seen,
116	    firstReadStep: found.read,
117	    readsBeforeCorrect: found.readsBefore,
118	    editedFiles,
119	    editedExpected: editedFiles.some(file => sources.has(file)),
120	    extraEdits: editedFiles.filter(file => !sources.has(file) && !tests.has(file)),
121	    editedTests: editedFiles.some(file => tests.has(file)),
122	    ...usage === undefined ? {} : { usage },
123	  }
124	}
125	
126	/**
127	 * Resolve a tool-supplied path to a workspace-relative `/`-separated path.
128	 * @param workspace - the run's workspace root.
129	 * @param path - the path the model passed, absolute or relative.
130	 * @returns the relative path, or undefined when absent or outside the workspace.
131	 */
132	export function workspacePath(workspace: string, path: string | undefined): string | undefined {
133	  if (path === undefined) return undefined
134	  const rel = relative(workspace, resolve(workspace, path))
135	  if (rel === '' || rel.startsWith('..') || isAbsolute(rel)) return undefined
136	  return rel.split('\\').join('/')
137	}
138	
139	function parseArguments(raw: unknown): unknown {
140	  if (typeof raw !== 'string') return raw
141	  try {
142	    return JSON.parse(raw) as unknown
143	  } catch {
144	    // Malformed model-written arguments name no file.
145	    return undefined
146	  }
147	}
148	
149	function filePathOf(args: unknown): string | undefined {
150	  if (typeof args !== 'object' || args === null) return undefined
151	  const record = args as Record<string, unknown>
152	  const path = record.file_path ?? record.path
153	  return typeof path === 'string' && path.length > 0 ? path : undefined
154	}
155	
156	function resultContent(data: Record<string, unknown>): unknown {
157	  const message = data.message as { content?: Array<{ content?: unknown }> } | undefined
158	  return message?.content?.[0]?.content
159	}
160	
161	function mentionsAny(content: unknown, files: readonly string[]): boolean {
162	  const text = JSON.stringify(content ?? '').split('\\\\').join('/')
163	  return files.some(file => text.includes(file))
164	}
165	
166	/** Aggregate over many runs, for the summary table. */
167	export interface MetricsSummary {
168	  readonly runs: number
169	  readonly passed: number
170	  readonly editedExpected: number
171	  readonly medianFirstReadStep: number | null
172	  readonly medianSteps: number | null
173	  readonly totalInputTokens: number
174	}
175	
176	/**
177	 * Summarize per-task results.
178	 * @param results - one entry per task with its pass flag and metrics.
179	 * @returns counts and medians across tasks.
180	 */
181	export function summarize(results: readonly { readonly passed: boolean; readonly metrics: RunMetrics }[]): MetricsSummary {
182	  return {
183	    runs: results.length,
184	    passed: results.filter(result => result.passed).length,
185	    editedExpected: results.filter(result => result.metrics.editedExpected).length,
186	    medianFirstReadStep: median(results.flatMap(result => result.metrics.firstReadStep ?? [])),
187	    medianSteps: median(results.map(result => result.metrics.steps)),
188	    totalInputTokens: results.reduce((total, result) => total + (result.metrics.usage?.inputTokens ?? 0), 0),
189	  }
190	}
191	
192	function median(values: readonly number[]): number | null {
193	  if (values.length === 0) return null
194	  const sorted = [...values].sort((a, b) => a - b)
195	  const mid = Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)
196	  const upper = sorted[mid] ?? 0
197	  return sorted.length % 2 === 1 ? upper : ((sorted[mid - 1] ?? 0) + upper) / 2
198	}
199
